embeds.title: 🔴 Exploit Code Published for Critical Flowise RCE Vulnerability
embeds.description:
Obsidian Security has released technical information and proof-of-concept code for CVE-2026-40933, a critical remote code execution vulnerability (CVSS 9.9) in Flowise, an open-source LLM platform. The vulnerability stems from unsafe serialization in Anthropic's MCP protocol, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary commands on servers by convincing users to import a crafted chatflow. Self-hosted Flowise instances are vulnerable by default, while Flowise Cloud is unaffected.
**Sources:** SecurityWeek • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-40933 • **Access:** Malicious chatflow import
